name: SpO2 from Haemoglobin Saturation (Parametric)
description: Pulse oximeter SpO2 reading is a parametric function of true haemoglobin oxygen saturation: SpO2 = a × SaO2 + b (Beer-Lambert approximation). Haemoglobin saturation uncertainty propagates parametrically to SpO2.

elements.name: True Haemoglobin Saturation
elements.description: True arterial haemoglobin oxygen saturation from co-oximetry.

uncertainty.source: PhysioNet VitalDB: co-oximetry SaO2 values from ICU arterial blood gas measurements

elements.name: Minimum SpO2 Alert Threshold
elements.description: WHO hypoxia alert: SpO2 below 94% requires clinical intervention

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(SaO2) = F·SaO2 + f; F=0.98, f=1.5 — parametric Beer-Lambert calibration maps SaO2 CZ to SpO2 CZ
consistency_relations.upr_description: Parametric UPR: SpO2 CZ is affine image of haemoglobin saturation CZ through oximeter calibration formula.
